name: Tornadic supercell
description: Low-level shear/helicity + low LCL + moist boundary layer over a buoyant, deeply-sheared environment. WFO Louisville tip sheet (Hodograph): 0-1 km SRH > 150 m2/s2, LCL <= 1000 m, boundary-layer RH > 65%, 0-6 km shear > 40 kt. Starting point — tune across cycles.
